text: {"question": "How does Hilpda expression change in the fatty liver of patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease?", "answer": "Hilpda expression is significantly increased in the fatty liver of patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.", "evidence": "The analysis of publicly available microarray datasets revealed that Hilpda expression is significantly increased in the fatty liver of patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, as well as in obese and type 2 diabetes model ob/ob mice, high-fat diet-fed mice, and mice fed a high-fat, cholesterol-, and fructose-enriched diet, all of which exhibit elevated PPARγ expression."}
